metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.4 · 1984 · The Karate Kid
metas.description: Recently relocated from NJ to LA, Daniel becomes the target of a gang of Cobra Kai dojo students. When Mr. Miyagi saves him with expert Karate skills, Daniel convinces him to teach him to defend himself, and put his bullies in the...

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 1986 · The Karate Kid Part II
metas.description: Daniel accompanies his mentor, Mr. Miyagi, to Miyagi's childhood home in Okinawa. Miyagi visits his dying father and confronts his old rival, while Daniel falls in love and inadvertently makes a new rival of his own.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.4 · 1989 · The Karate Kid Part III
metas.description: Ostracised villain John Kreese attempts to gain revenge on Daniel and Miyagi, with the help of a Vietnam War comrade, the wealthy owner of a toxic waste disposal business.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.6 · 1994 · The Next Karate Kid
metas.description: Mr. Miyagi is back and he takes a new pupil under his wing: a troubled adolescent girl.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.3 · 2010 · The Karate Kid
metas.description: Work causes a single mother to move to China with her young son; in his new home, the 12-year-old boy embraces Kung Fu, taught to him by a master.
